language_task: Pick up the spoon and place it into the box.
outcome_evidence: The spoon is acquired and lifted clear of the table in frames 52–64 (wrist_left and wrist_right), then transferred between grippers in frames 95–105 (ceiling, wrist_left and wrist_right). The robot lowers it into the blue box and releases it in frames 120–135 (ceiling and wrist_right). Frames 140–155 (ceiling) show the spoon remaining inside the box as the gripper withdraws. No failed acquisition, harmful collision, or unintended side effect is visible.
